summary: Federal fire tower built near Kinzua in 1924 on Coal Knob, 30 feet tall with a glass observatory; only two foundation blocks remain, per the register.

facts.design: 30-foot federal tower with a 14 by 14 foot plate-glass observatory and observer's quarters at the top
facts.status_note: Only two foundation blocks remain of the tower, per the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register.

notes_for_editor: Built date rests on 1924 newspaper items quoted by the Forest Lookouts page; the newspapers themselves were not checked. The page's May and August 1927 items look like dating problems or a later project: the August 1927 item repeats the August 1924 steel-delivery wording word for word. Removal date and fate beyond the register's foundation-blocks note were not found in one web search. Record design and height_m were null; the 30-foot figure comes from the 1924 newspaper and sits in facts.design, not height_m, because it may be overall height. The trail-guide page is a paid listing; only its public summary was read, and it does not mention the lookout. Staffing names were not found.
